The sun was hot, so Tom and his mom were watching a show. They had a lot of fun, until their mom came to the kitchen. They took a big bite and a sour lemon from the bag. 
"Thank you, Mom. The wishing made a big cake!" shouted Tom. His mom smiled and kept walking.
"That's okay, Tom. It's so hot," said Mom. "Now we can go outside together and find some things."
Lily felt happy and grateful. She knew that Tom was good at climbing trees, and he could do anything too.
